extracted.name: Sweet and Creamy Cranberry Salad
extracted.description: This creamy cranberry fruit salad recipe is reminiscent of a Waldorf salad and contains cranberries, apples, marshmallows, nuts, and yogurt.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 ounce) package fresh cranberries, finely chopped
1 cup frozen whipped topping (such as Cool Whip®), thawed
instruction_lines: Combine chopped cranberries and sugar in a large, nonreactive bowl. Toss well. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours.
After 3 hours, stir apples, marshmallows, and pecans into cranberries. Combine yogurt and whipped topping; fold into cranberry salad. Serve immediately.
